Driven by thm-line-integrals-under-reversal-and-concatenation gaining explicit continuity hypotheses on its scalar and vector fields. This adds no burden: def-scalar-and-vector-line-integrals-along-piecewise-c1-paths defines a line integral only for a continuous field on a set containing the trace, so any item writing such an integral already presupposes continuity. Read this consumer on disk and confirmed its field is continuous (C^1, polynomial, or continuous by stated hypothesis). No propagation.

Driven by def-closed-and-exact-c1-vector-fields being reindexed from a one-based component list (F_1..F_n, 1<=i,j<=n) to the library's zero-based convention (F_0..F_{n-1}, i,j<n). The mathematical content — symmetry of the Jacobian — is unchanged. Consumers that use abstract indices are unaffected; the three consumers that named concrete components in R^2 were reindexed in the same pass. No propagation.
